quarterly_data.quarter: Eli Lilly press release: Lilly's Jaypirca (pirtobrutinib), the first-and-only (10-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The U.S. FDA approved an additional indication for Jaypirca (pirtobrutinib, 100 mg and 50 mg tablets), a non-covalent BTK inhibitor, for adults with previously untreated chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma (CLL/SLL) with no known 17p deletion, allowing first-line use for appropriate patients. The approval rests on the Phase 3 BRUIN CLL-313 trial versus bendamustine plus rituximab (n=141 per arm): at a median follow-up of 28 months, IRC-assessed progression-free survival improved with HR=0.20 (median not yet reached versus 33.5 months), and overall response rate was 94% versus 81%. Lilly calls Jaypirca the first-and-only FDA-approved non-covalent BTK inhibitor (company claim). Jacob Van Naarden, president of Lilly Oncology: the approval expands 'its potential to reach more patients who may benefit - this time as an initial treatment.'
